purpose: Prevent robotic or choppy narration caused by synthesizing subtitle fragments as separate TTS clips.

rules.numericNormalization: Write numbers as they should be spoken in PT-BR when ambiguity or punctuation could create a break.
rules.sentenceBoundaryRule: Every synthesized scene must end at a natural punctuation boundary.
rules.visualNarrationRule: Scene visual must match the exact narration beat; subtitle timing must never be used to force audio segmentation.

rootCauseRecord.cause: render_video split narration into approximately eight-word caption fragments, synthesized each fragment with a separate TTS call, and concatenated the clips. This introduced audible micro-pauses inside sentences and around numbers.
rootCauseRecord.correctiveAction: Decouple subtitle chunks from speech synthesis. Synthesize the complete scene/paragraph once; captions remain visual-only and may be split independently.
